newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA NEWS HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA NEWS HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea and his cabinet met Poul Thomsen, the International Monetary Fund's chief negotiator for Romania.
* The government is expected to hold its weekly meeting on Monday starting at 1 p.m. to discuss revising the 1997 budget.

* Gheorghe Funar, mayor of the central city of Cluj, wrote an open letter to Ciorbea to protest against a law allowing the existance of bilingual street signs in localities inhabited by ethnic minorities.
Funar said the measure allows the "Hungarianisation" of Romanian names.
